_why.45-terminal-short: A short shell session (one command, then the prompt: bridge.ts mockTranscript 'short') fills a line or two and leaves the rest of the tile empty below the prompt - what a terminal with little in it is. Its full-session variant (45-terminal) fits at every size. Resizing a shell's text to fill would make its size jump with every command, so it's kept as a terminal.
_why.50-weather~extreme: Its widest values ('-13°C', 'Heavy snow', no place) on a wide 2-3 row tile: the lines are as big as the height allows and still short of the width (~15% empty each side) - nothing is cut. Tried: the sky beside the temperature (starved the temperature), the place kept (shrank both), bigger sky caps (0.75 of the temperature). A real fix is a different wide layout for short values.
_why.dev.powos.counter.count: A dev sample, not a user-facing widget: apps/counter is the Tier 0 prototype of the app runtime (a shared count over SpacetimeDB, its connection, latency and version shown for checking the pipeline). Its tiles are a test readout, not designed to fill; listed here so the sweep stays honest for real widgets. Drop this entry if it ever ships as a real widget.
